name: elecrusion-workspace
description: Task runner cho hai package frontend/ và backend/. Không bao giờ được đóng gói.

scripts.dev:backend: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist:win
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:shared
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
